task.description:
Implement the React Flow visual canvas components for PD-UI-09 through PD-UI-12. Follow the design artefact at src/design/canvas-f2-batch1.md exactly. Do NOT create a separate feature branch — the branch already exists as feature/WF02-f2a-canvas-batch1-20260528. Just implement, commit, and push to it. See docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md for final merge protocol. Install @xyflow/react v12.x as dependency. Create the following files under web/src/:
- components/canvas/ProcessCanvas.tsx (main canvas wrapper)
- components/canvas/NodePalette.tsx (sidebar palette)
- components/canvas/PropertyPanel.tsx (node property editor)
- components/canvas/ValidationSummaryBar.tsx (inline feedback)
- components/canvas/ConditionDialog.tsx (CEL prompt on edge creation)
- components/canvas/nodes/STARTNode.tsx, ENDNode.tsx, HumanTaskNode.tsx, ServiceTaskNode.tsx
- components/canvas/nodes/ExclusiveGatewayNode.tsx, ParallelGatewayNode.tsx, TimerNode.tsx, SubProcessNode.tsx
- components/canvas/edges/ConditionEdge.tsx
- utils/canvas/graphToFlow.ts (DefinitionGraph -> React Flow nodes/edges)
- utils/canvas/flowToGraph.ts (React Flow -> DefinitionGraph JSON)
- stores/canvasStore.ts (Zustand store for local state)
- Modify pages/definitions/DefinitionEditorPage.tsx to integrate the canvas
- Modify types/api.ts if any type additions needed

Validation commands after implementation:
cd web && npm run type-check
cd web && npm run lint
cd web && npm run build

Commit and push:
git add -A
git commit -m "feat(WF02-f2a-canvas-batch1): implement React Flow canvas (PD-UI-09..12)"
git push origin feature/WF02-f2a-canvas-batch1-20260528
acceptance_criteria: ProcessCanvas renders with React Flow nodes from graph API data
NodePalette shows all 8 NodeType options, drag-and-drop adds nodes to canvas
PropertyPanel opens on node click, shows type-specific fields
Edge creation by dragging between handles works, ConditionDialog prompts for CEL
Save button serializes canvas state back to DefinitionGraph and calls PUT
Graph-to-flow and flow-to-graph converters are bijective for valid graphs
